title: Hankel Submatrices with Bounded Word Length: Dimension Tradeoffs in Probabilistic and Quantum Automata
summary: We characterize the largest admissible side length of fixed-margin square Hankel submatrices generated by probabilistic realizations on a \(d\)-point carrier and quantum linear realizations on a \(d\)-dimensional Hilbert space, when prefix and suffix word lengths are bounded by \(T\).
